term: least graph foundation, supplied contribution, intrinsic existence and adequate explanation
resolution: Supply is the existing inductive all-contributor standard, not full explanation. A least graph node has finite ancestry paths to every event, whereas a minimal source only has no incoming arrow; neither entails joint Supply. Two indispensable intrinsically powered contributors may jointly supply a target without a least source. Intrinsic in a chosen exercise respect is not necessarily underived existence of its bearer. The modal overlay explicitly preserves actual occurrence/graph but stipulates separate bearer modal statuses; it does not derive ontic necessity from power. Necessary reason truth requires a separate necessitation condition for a necessary effect; copied entailing truth is still not independent explanatory content. Single-source theistic and impersonal readings receive the same open real-nature/applicability burden. See docs/notes/ultimate-adequacy-integration-735.md. No attributed source uses these fixtures as a definition of adequate explanation.
